author: Athul Prem
scope: One 1 GHz two-hole control with nominal fixed-property cubic Ge, fixed 48-segment hole geometry and fixed 135-DOF ports. The thresholds apply to the final 60 to 50 nm body-mesh comparison. Continuum error, whole-band accuracy and the full 26-hole device require separate evidence.
phase_reference: Port reference planes are fixed at the beam ends. Raw matrices use time-reversed port bases with row and column block order left, right. Complex arrays store [real, imaginary] pairs.

failed_h60_export.author: Athul Prem
failed_h60_export.stage: writing completed numerical scattering data to JSON
failed_h60_export.error: TypeError: Object of type int32 is not JSON serializable
failed_h60_export.detail: The worker completed both incidence solves and exited with code 1 during export. The last saved scattering record is the pre-solve record with status running. The numerical result existed only in the exited worker and is unavailable.
failed_h60_export.monitor_limitation: Windows virtual environment launcher RSS was measured instead of the full worker process tree. System available memory remained at least 2635.738 MiB in the sampled record.
